module_summary: Lemmings-style walker controller: a 4-state one-hot Moore FSM walks left/right, reverses on bumps, falls when ground is lost and resumes direction on landing.

anchors.name: mv
anchors.why: One-hot state: walk west/east and falling west/east

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from walking-west state bit

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from walking-east state bit

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Falling indication decoded from either drop state bit

anchors.name: to_east
anchors.why: Next-direction decision from bumps and current state

anchors.name: mv_shadow
anchors.why: Rotated shadow copy of state with no consumers

groups.name: Walker FSM
groups.description: One-hot direction/fall FSM with decoded Moore outputs
